title: Interaction and Motion designer
description:
Interaction and Motion designer Description - About the Role Were building the operating system for a next-generation device, and were looking for a talented Interaction Designer to shape how it feels to use . This role is centered around interaction design and motion - the details that make an interface feel alive, responsive, intuitive, and delightful. Youll define how the OS behaves at a moment-to-moment level: how things move, respond, transition, provide feedback, and communicate state. Your primary focus will be bringing craft, consistency, and delight to the experience across the OS. Youll help define the interaction language of the product and ensure that interactions feel cohesive rather than a collection of individual features. Alongside this, youll contribute to selected UX and UI projects with the broader design team, either independently or in collaboration with other designers. What Youll Do Define what "delight" means for the product and translate it into thoughtful, purposeful interactions across the OS. Own the interaction design and micro-animation layer of the OS, including transitions, spatial relationships, feedback, gestures, states, loading, success/error, sound, haptics and other moment-to-moment behaviors. Collaborate with product designers, product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to brainstorm and develop interaction concepts for the device. Define and maintain a consistent interaction language so that behaviors across the OS feel unified and intentional, across different modal behaviors like touch, trackpad, keyboard and stylus. Build, maintain, and evolve an interaction library covering reusable patterns, behaviors, motion principles, timing, and transitions. Contribute to the broader design system and work with other designers to ensure interaction patterns are documented, consistent, and reusable. Prototype interactions using tools such as Figma, Principle, ProtoPie, After Effects, or code-based prototyping. Use prototypes to communicate not just visual behavior, but also motion, timing, sound, feedback, and overall feel. Partner closely with engineering throughout implementation to ensure interactions are brought to life with a high level of design fidelity. Review builds, identify interaction or motion inconsistencies, and work with engineers to refine the experience while taking feasibility and performance into account. Explore emerging interaction patterns, motion techniques, and interaction paradigms across leading products globally, bringing relevant ideas and inspiration into the product. Contribute to UX and UI projects across the product team, either independently owning selected projects or supporting other UX designers with interaction design and prototyping. What Were Looking For A portfolio that clearly demonstrates strong interaction design and motion/micro-animation craft. This is the most important qualification for this role. The ability to take ownership of interactions across an OS and drive them from concept through implementation with engineering. Strong prototyping skills - youre comfortable communicating interactions through working prototypes rather than static screens alone. An understanding of motion as a tool for usability, hierarchy, feedback, continuity, and delight - not simply as visual decoration. Strong design judgment and restraint: knowing when motion adds value and when simplicity is the better experience. Working knowledge of design systems and how interaction patterns can be made consistent, reusable, and scalable. Comfort working across both craft-heavy interaction design and broader product design work. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions to product managers, designers, engineers, and leadership. The ability to work directly with engineers on implementation details and advocate for interaction quality and design fidelity. Experience working with sound or other forms of sensory feedback as part of interaction design. Nice to Have Experience designing for an OS-level, system-level, or gaming platform , rather than only individual applications. Experience with tablet, mobile, or multi-modal interaction design involving combinations of touch, keyboard, pen, or other input methods. Familiarity with the performance considerations of animation on devices, including frame rates, GPU constraints, and how these influence interaction design decisions. A background in motion design, game UI, or consumer products with rich micro-interactions. 
 Education Experience Recommended 
 - Four-year or Graduate Degree in Design, Human Factors Engineering, Social Sciences research, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. Around 5 years of experience across UI, UX, and, most importantly, interaction design.

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Kubernetes Platform & Networking
description:
Who are we Equinix is the worlds digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriersbecause progress starts with fresh ideas. Youll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes youbecause when you feel valued, youre empowered to do your best work. Job Summary We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform''s architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps. This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves. You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems. Responsibilities OS Provisioning Bare-Metal Infrastructure Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them Kubernetes Control Plane Worker Nodes Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded CI/CD Data Plane Deployment Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks Network Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over OS Kubernetes Upgrades Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live Apply the platform''s patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components Management Plane Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free On-Call Incident Management Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements Qualifications Required OS bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations Preferred Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent) Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability.If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing this form. description:
Position Summary: 
Join athenahealths Marketing BI team as a Business Intelligence Associate - a highly technical and impactful role focused on building, scaling, and maintaining trusted marketing performance insights. In this role, you will be responsible for hands-on data manipulation, advanced SQL querying, and high-performance Power BI dashboard development, turning complex commercial and campaign data into actionable insights for our Marketing department. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical professional who possesses strong data management and visualization capabilities to clean, transform, and analyse large-scale marketing campaign and performance data. About the Team: The Marketing Operations team enables data-driven decision making across athenahealths Marketing organization by developing scalable analytics, reporting, and performance frameworks. The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales, Finance, IT, and Data Engineering to align on go-to-market performance, pipeline measurement, and reporting standards. They manage a broad analytics ecosystem spanning CRM, marketing automation, and enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake and Power BI. The teams mission is to improve the quality, consistency, and accessibility of insights that drive business growth. Essential Job Responsibilities: Power BI Development & Visualization: Build, publish, and maintain business-critical Power BI dashboards. Design efficient star-schema data models, establish seamless relationship mappings, and write advanced DAX calculations (using filter context manipulation, time intelligence, and dynamic security rules). SQL Data Preparation & Processing: Write, debug, and optimize complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, analytical window functions, and multi-table joins) to extract, aggregate, and model raw marketing data from platforms like Snowflake. Advanced Data Handling & Auditing: Manipulate and clean massive, complex datasets from Salesforce CRM and marketing platforms. Act as a gatekeeper of data quality by utilizing advanced Excel techniques (Power Query, nested lookups, dynamic arrays) to validate, reconcile, and audit spreadsheet metrics against final dashboards. KPI Standardization: Implement and maintain standardized marketing KPI definitions and reporting logic across dashboards to ensure consistent "single source of truth" metrics. Legacy Dashboard Rationalization: Reverse-engineer, simplify, and document legacy spreadsheets and Power BI reports to eliminate redundant reporting and improve performance. Stakeholder Collaboration: Translate marketing business questions into exact technical reporting requirements, presenting data insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Additional Job Responsibilities Support ad hoc marketing analysis and custom reporting requests across campaigns, segments, and channels. Collaborate with broader data and IT teams to validate data flows and ensure business reporting accuracy. Promote best practices in query performance, data modelling, and clean visual design within the immediate team. Perform thorough QA and data validation testing on all developed dashboards prior to executive rollouts. Required Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field. 5 years of overall experience and 3+ years of Data analytics, Data Visualization and hands-on Data Manipulation using SQL and Excel. Advanced SQL expertise, including writing and optimizing queries to gather and process large-scale datasets from Snowflake or similar cloud databases. Hands-on experience with data manipulation, lookup functions (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP), and data validation tools to handle large volumes of reporting data. Proven experience designing and building user-friendly Power BI reports, including DAX query creation, data modeling, and performance optimization. Working experience interacting, engaging, and transforming Salesforce CRM data objects such as Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities. Prior experience in US Healthcare or B2B commercial marketing/sales organizations. Familiarity with marketing funnel metrics across prospect lifecycle journey Familiarity with marketing automation tools and standard campaign performance metrics. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.

 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, from architecture to implementation. Strong grasp of software engineering best practices: Agile workflows, CI/CD, TDD, code reviews, and build/release automation. Experience working with Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with short release cycles and products in active production use. Deep knowledge of OOP principles, data structures, and algorithms. Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating AI tools into development workflows, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Committed to sound business ethics and handling of confidential information. Experience working in Product Operating Model is a plus.

title: Data Architect
description:
Data Architect The Role We are building our enterprise data platform from the ground up and need a Data Architect to own it. This is a greenfield, hands-on leadership role - not a consulting engagement. You will define the architecture, make the technology decisions, build the foundation, and be accountable for outcomes. You will report directly to the CTO and partner closely with a Senior Data Engineer on the same hiring cycle. The platform will serve business analytics, operational reporting, and AI-driven capabilities across multiple markets and enterprise clients. A key deliverable is enabling AI applications and agents to consume trusted enterprise data securely via APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) . What You Will Own Data platform architecture - Data Lake, Lakehouse, semantic layers, and data consumption patterns across structured, semi-structured, and event-based sources. Ingestion and transformation pipelines - batch, streaming, and CDC-based, with proper orchestration, observability, and failure handling. Data modelling - scalable analytical models covering core business domains: orders, inventory, fulfilment, logistics, marketplaces, billing, and platform performance. Business analytics - governed KPI definitions, dashboards, and self-service capabilities that replace manual reporting. AI data enablement - architecture for exposing authoritative, governed data to AI agents through MCP and APIs, with appropriate access controls and tenant isolation. Data governance and compliance - data quality, lineage, PII classification, and controls that meet enterprise security and privacy obligations across multiple jurisdictions. Platform reliability - monitoring, SLAs, incident management, and operational runbooks so the platform runs as a production service. What We Expect First 90 days: Weeks 1-4: Assess the data landscape, produce an enterprise architecture proposal. Weeks 5-8: Deliver the first production pipeline and a priority BI dashboard. Weeks 9-12: Define common KPI models for two business domains and deliver the first MCP-based data capability for an AI agent. 6-12 months: Production data platform operational with automated pipelines for priority datasets. Governed business models and trusted KPI definitions in active use by the business. Dashboards live and replacing manual reporting. Architecture for secure AI data consumption implemented, with initial MCP capabilities in production. Platform operational practices - quality, lineage, monitoring, cost controls - established and running. What We Are Looking For 10+ years across data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture - with real architecture ownership, not just delivery. Proven experience designing and building enterprise Data Lake, Warehouse, or Lakehouse platforms. Strong SQL, data modelling, pipeline design, and cloud-native (preferably AWS) skills. Experience with governance, data quality, lineage, and compliance - including PII and privacy controls. Hands-on enough to validate designs and build in the early phase; structured enough to define standards that scale. Experience in eCommerce, logistics, marketplace, or B2B SaaS is strongly preferred - the domain is complex and ramp time matters. Desirable: Practical experience with MCP, LLM/AI integration, semantic layers, RAG, or secure enterprise data access for AI systems. The Opportunity This is a founding role. The data platform does not yet exist. You will define what good looks like at Anchanto - and build it. If you are energised by greenfield architecture, comfortable with high ownership, and capable of moving fluently from business question to data pipeline to AI consumption - we want to talk.

title: Customer Success Manager - Field Operations
description:

 We are looking for a Customer Success Manager / Project Manager to own partner projects end to end from launching a pilot and building the operational funnel to scaling successful projects across cities. This is a hands-on operations + partner management + project management role. You will work closely with platform partners, women candidates, field teams, vehicle/EV partners and internal teams to deliver measurable project outcomes. 
 The role requires someone who is comfortable working in the field, building processes from scratch and taking complete ownership of project outcomes. 
 About Aatm Nirbhar 
 Aatm Nirbhar is a women-led social enterprise helping women move safely and earn independently through skilling, mobility enablement and livelihood opportunities. We operate a network of women trainers across 19 cities and work with partners including Urban Company, Swiggy, Yes Madam and L&T Finance to train and enable women partners and riders. We are a profitable, for-profit company building solutions in the mobility and livelihood space. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Project & Operations Management Own partner projects from launch through execution and scale. Build and manage operational processes for new projects and cities. Track project performance, identify bottlenecks and drive corrective action. Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and targets. 2. Lead Generation & Candidate Conversion Drive lead generation through digital campaigns, community networks, catchment-area activities, partner referrals and field mobilisation. Build and manage local recruitment channels and networks. Qualify and counsel women interested in delivery and mobility-based livelihood opportunities. Work with candidates and, where required, their families to address concerns and enable conversion. 3. Training & Rider Onboarding Coordinate training delivery and ensure candidates complete training. Manage onboarding onto partner platforms/apps. Coordinate with vehicle dealers, OEMs, EV rental providers and lending partners to facilitate vehicle access. Track rider activation, adoption and retention after onboarding. 4. Partner / Client Management Own day-to-day relationships with partner stakeholders. Understand partner requirements and translate them into operational execution. Build strong working relationships with city/regional leadership and project stakeholders. Identify opportunities to improve project performance and expand the partnership. 5. Team Management Hire, train and manage field recruiters and tele-callers as project volume grows. Set targets, monitor performance and ensure team productivity. Build local teams and operational networks for new cities. 6. Project Scale & Expansion Replicate successful pilot models across new cities. Launch and stabilise operations in new markets. Monitor performance of established markets and protect existing revenue. Identify opportunities for revenue growth and expansion within existing partnerships. Key Success Metrics Performance will be measured against clear business and operational outcomes, including: Training completion Rider / vehicle adoption Rider activation and retention Project delivery within timelines Partner satisfaction and engagement New partner/project launches Revenue protection and revenue growth Successful launch and stabilisation of new cities Field team productivity and performance 
 What Were Looking For 
 Experience 48 years of experience in gig economy operations, last-mile logistics, delivery operations, field operations, workforce management, partner operations or customer success . Experience managing rider, driver, delivery partner or service-partner supply is highly relevant. Hands-on experience managing field teams, catchment areas or local recruitment networks. Experience working with external clients, platform partners or business stakeholders.

Comfortable working with data, dashboards and operational metrics. Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability. Excellent communication and coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously. Willingness to travel and work closely with field teams. 
 Youll Do Well Here If You Are comfortable operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Take ownership rather than waiting for instructions or established processes. Are comfortable spending time in the field and solving problems on the ground. Can build relationships with both senior partner stakeholders and frontline teams. Are driven by measurable outcomes and business impact. Can build and manage teams as the project scales. 
 What This Role Is Like This is a hands-on role in a fast-growing, evolving environment. Projects may require building processes from scratch, working across multiple stakeholders and adapting quickly to changing ground realities. It is suited to someone who wants significant ownership over an outcome and enjoys solving operational problems rather than working within a fixed playbook.

title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Senior Test Automation Engineer 
 Desktop, Web & Cloud Application Test Automation 
 What You'll Do Lead the design and build of our test automation from the ground up. Decide how we structure and organize automated testing across our desktop and web applications, so the approach is consistent and easy to build on. Check the quality of the team's work before it goes in and help fix problems when something isn't working well. Mentor and guide a junior engineer as they learn test automation from scratch. Be the person the team comes to when a tricky technical decision or problem needs to be resolved. 
 Technology Skills We Need Strong, hands-on coding experience in Python and/or Java. Experience using a test automation framework such as pytest, TestNG, or JUnit. Experience automating desktop applications (tools like pywinauto or WinAppDriver). Experience automating web applications (tools like Selenium or Playwright). Experience testing APIs/backend services (e.g. using Postman), not just what's visible on screen. Comfortable working with databases (e.g. MySQL, SQL Server) to check data is correct. Experience using Git (e.g. GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket) to manage code changes as part of a team. Experience setting up automated test runs using a CI/CD tool such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions, so tests run without manual effort each time. Familiarity with an issue-tracking or test management tool such as JIRA or Azure DevOps is a plus. 
 Behaviour We're Looking For Comfortable building something new from the ground up, without an existing template or system to copy. Takes ownership accountable for decisions and their outcomes, not just for finishing tasks. A natural mentor patient, clear, and genuinely invested in helping a less experienced engineer grow. Comfortable giving direct, constructive feedback on someone else's work. Stays calm and methodical when something breaks and needs to be tracked down. 
 Quality We Expect Test scripts that are reliable and consistent — they don't randomly fail for no real reason. Code and notes that another engineer could pick up and understand without needing to ask the author. Consistent standards applied across the whole team's work, not just their own. Tests that genuinely catch real problems, not just tests that are written to always pass. 
 Nice to Have Not required — a bonus if a candidate already has some of this: Understanding of how serialization / track-and-trace systems work. Exposure to camera-based or vision inspection systems. Basic awareness of industrial automation (PLCs) or industrial printers. Awareness of quality/compliance standards such as ISO or 21 CFR Part 11. A software testing certification such as ISTQB. 
 Experience Required 7–10 years of hands-on software test automation experience overall. Has personally built a test automation setup from scratch before — not just added tests to one that already existed. Has experience mentoring, leading, or reviewing the work of less experienced engineers. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

title: Sr Analyst SAP GRC (SAP Governance)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Sr. SAP Governance Analyst. This person will play a critical role in ensuring SAP compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX), company policies, and industry best practices. This position is responsible for supporting the development of SAP standards and operating procedures, designing, executing, and enforcing SAP IT internal controls (e.g., user access reviews, change reviews), training stakeholders on SAP compliance requirements, developing SAP governance strategies, managing risks, and improving operational efficiencies.
The ideal candidate will be proactive, hands-on, and results oriented. 
 MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES 
• Develop and implement SAP policies, procedures, and guidelines, review exception requests, and oversee enforcement.
• Design and govern role-based access control strategies for SAP systems; provide clear guidance for the SAP Security team. Define and propose data protection and privacy protocols such as encryption and masking.
• Develop and maintain SAP internal controls environment documentation (e.g., process flows, narratives, control matrices, segregation of duties rulesets, role security matrices, etc.).
• Monitor compliance to the end-to-end SAP user access lifecycle, including role assignment, segregation of duties conflict management, approvals, periodic access reviews, and deprovisioning as well as the elevated access management process. Propose process improvements and security enhancements. Execute controls.
• Design, implement, and monitor SAP system adherence to software development lifecycle, job monitoring, and other applicable SAP controls. Ensure secure system parameters are defined and configured.
• Assist with the development of corrective action plans to address SAP internal control deficiencies and the timely remediation of the deficiencies.
• Define and enforce SAP role design and maintenance, including role and authorization object creation, revision, testing, and disablement.
• Respond to SAP Security-related incidents.
• Maintain segregation of duties ruleset in accordance with business process requirements and enforce rules that prevent conflicts of interest.
• Mature the overall SAP controls environment; drive towards automation and continuous monitoring practices.
• Prepare for and facilitate internal and external audits, gathering and providing required documentation and evidence of compliance.
• Provide training and guidance regarding SAP policies, control procedures, and tools to control owners, role owners/access approvers, and system end users.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop, implement, and remediate SAP processes and controls. Develop and manage relationships with IT and cross-functional stakeholders. Work with cross-functional teams and SAP architects to embed security into all SAP projects.
• Track and manage key performance indicators; generate dashboards and reports needed to effectively communicate SAP security risks, segregation of duties conflicts, and other compliance metrics.
• Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS
 Education
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, Engineering, Accounting, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
Certification / Licensure
 Work Experience: 
• Total 5 + Years and 3+ or more years of experience in Internal Controls, SAP Security, SAP Administration, IT Internal Audit, and/or Information Security
• Must have experience working in a large and complex SAP environment
• Must have experience with Sarbanes-Oxley compliance
Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
 Familiarity with using modern GRC or other workflow tools to effectively manage SAP controls execution
• In-depth understanding of IT internal controls (i.e., Change Management, Access, IT Operations, segregation of duties rulesets, SDLC)
• Experience developing and maintaining internal controls documentation (e.g., risk control matrices, narratives, process flows, etc.)
• Strong written and verbal skills, including a demonstrated ability to translate complex or technical information into concepts that are easily understood
• Strong analytical, problem solving, and critical thinking skills, including the ability to anticipate issues and to design appropriate solutions
• Excellent teamwork skills
• Detail and deadline oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously with limited supervision
• Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Visio)

We're looking for a Mobile App Developer / PWA Specialist to build fast, reliable web applications that work beautifully on phones and tablets even when there's no internet connection. Our users are often out in the field, so the apps you build need to just work, wherever they are.

description:
Role Summary 
 We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support for Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) and robotic automation systems at customer sites. The engineer will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex issues spanning software, embedded systems, networking, controls, electrical systems, and mechanical integration. The role requires strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and the ability to work across multiple engineering disciplines. Key Responsibilities 
 Commission and validate robotic systems at customer sites. Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, electrical, and networking issues. Perform root cause analysis for field failures and recommend corrective actions. Support installation, configuration, calibration, and acceptance testing of robotic systems. Debug ROS-based software stacks and system-level integrations. Analyze system logs, diagnostics, and performance data to identify failures. Work closely with Product Engineering, Controls, Mechanical, Electronics, and Software teams to resolve complex technical issues. Document field observations, investigation reports, and corrective actions. Develop and execute validation procedures for new features and fixes. Support customers remotely and onsite during commissioning and production operations. Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to product development teams to improve product reliability. Required Technical Skills 

 Robotics & Automation 
 Robotics fundamentals Mobile robot kinematics Localization and Navigation concepts SLAM fundamentals Path planning concepts Motion control fundamentals Sensor integration

 ROS / ROS2 Linux (Ubuntu) C++ and/or Python Shell scripting Git 
 Embedded & Controls 
 Embedded systems fundamentals PLC interaction CAN, RS485, UART, Modbus communication Motor controllers and drive systems Sensor interfaces

 TCP/IP fundamentals Ethernet networking IP configuration Routing and switching basics Network diagnostics using common tools 
 Diagnostics & Validation 
 Log analysis System debugging Root cause analysis Failure reproduction Functional testing Integration testing 
 Desired Knowledge 
 LiDAR, Camera, IMU, Encoder integration Safety scanners and industrial safety systems Industrial automation Warehouse automation AGV/AMR systems Industrial communication protocols Field commissioning experience 
 Core Competencies 
 Strong analytical and logical reasoning Systems thinking Structured problem-solving Hypothesis-driven debugging Root cause analysis Attention to detail Ability to work under time-critical situations Cross-functional collaboration Technical documentation and reporting Customer-facing communication 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or related discipline. 2-6 years of experience in robotics, industrial automation, embedded systems, or technical support. Experience with AMRs, AGVs, autonomous systems, or industrial automation products is preferred. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 The successful candidate will be able to: Independently diagnose and resolve complex system-level issues. Identify the root cause of field failures rather than treating symptoms. Work effectively across software, hardware, controls, and mechanical domains. Communicate technical findings clearly to both customers and internal engineering teams. Contribute to continuous improvement by feeding field learnings back into product development.

title: Network Automation Engineer SolarWinds Specialist
description:
Network Automation Engineer SolarWinds Specialist Job Description Role Overview We are seeking a Network Automation Engineer with deep SolarWinds expertise to modernize and automate the management of our existing production network infrastructure. In this role, you will move beyond basic monitoring to unlock the full automation, orchestration, and configuration management capabilities of the SolarWinds platform . Your mission will be to eliminate manual workflows by leveraging SolarWinds Network Configuration Manager (NCM), Orion SDK/SolarWinds Information Service (SWIS), APIs, and scripting to build a highly automated, self-healing, and compliant network environment. Key Responsibilities 1. SolarWinds Automation & Orchestration Design, implement, and maintain advanced automation workflows primarily using SolarWinds Network Configuration Manager (NCM) and Orion SDK/SolarWinds Information Service (SWIS) . Develop custom Python, PowerShell, or Ansible scripts that interface with the SolarWinds API to automate routine provisioning, patching, and configuration tasks. Build automated compliance reports and remediation scripts within NCM to automatically correct policy violations across multi-vendor network devices. Automate repetitive network administration and configuration activities while maintaining appropriate production controls. 2. Legacy Network Modernization & Remediation Audit existing manual network processes and translate them into automated SolarWinds alerting actions, scripts, and job schedules where appropriate. Leverage SolarWinds alerting engines to trigger automated troubleshooting and self-healing scripts, such as auto-remediating interface flaps or routing anomalies. Maintain gold-standard configuration templates within SolarWinds to ensure consistency across routers, switches, and firewalls. Identify opportunities to replace manual operational processes with repeatable and controlled automation. 3. Integration & Telemetry Expansion Integrate SolarWinds with external IT Service Management (ITSM) systems such as ServiceNow or Jira to automate ticket creation, updating, and closure based on network events. Connect SolarWinds with IPAM and database systems to automate subnet allocations and inventory tracking. Customize SolarWinds dashboards, PerfStack, and NetPath to provide real-time visibility into complex network paths and performance metrics. Develop and maintain integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and process JSON/XML data. 4. Governance & Training Manage the health, scaling, and polling efficiency of the SolarWinds infrastructure, including Additional Polling Engines and SQL database optimization for monitoring data. Act as the internal SolarWinds SME , supporting and training traditional network engineers on how to safely utilize SolarWinds automation capabilities. Document automation intents, workflows, codebases, standard operating procedures, expected results, validation processes, and error handling. Ensure automated production changes follow appropriate validation, change-management, and rollback procedures. Required Technical Skills SolarWinds Deep hands-on experience with the SolarWinds Orion suite . Strong experience with SolarWinds Network Configuration Manager (NCM) . Experience with Network Performance Monitor (NPM) and NetFlow Traffic Analyzer (NTA) . Experience with SolarWinds alerting, configuration templates, compliance policies, reporting, and automation workflows. API & Automation Strong proficiency with the SolarWinds API / Orion SDK / SWIS . Hands-on experience with SwisPowerShell and/or the OrionSDK Python library . Strong scripting experience using Python and/or PowerShell . Experience with Ansible is preferred. Ability to develop scripts that extract data from SolarWinds and/or push configuration changes. Network Engineering Strong foundational knowledge of traditional networking, including: TCP/IP Switching and VLANs Routing BGP and OSPF Firewalls and network security Multi-vendor network environments Cisco, Aruba, NetScaler, or similar networking technologies Systems Integration Experience working with REST/SOAP APIs . Strong understanding of JSON and XML data formats. Experience integrating network monitoring/automation platforms with external systems such as ServiceNow, Jira, IPAM, or databases . Database & Reporting Working knowledge of SQL and SWQL (SolarWinds Query Language) . Experience creating custom SolarWinds reports, queries, dashboards, and data extractions. Understanding of SolarWinds SQL database and monitoring-data management is preferred. Experience & Qualifications 2+ years of experience in Network Engineering , with at least 1+ year of hands-on experience managing and automating networks using SolarWinds . Strong hands-on experience with SolarWinds NCM and SolarWinds API/SWIS/Orion SDK is required. Experience developing automation using Python, PowerShell, or Ansible . Strong understanding of enterprise network infrastructure and multi-vendor environments. Experience working with production networks and implementing controlled automation. Ability to analyze manual troubleshooting and operational processes and translate them into programmatic automation workflows. Strong understanding of risk management, validation, testing, change control, and rollback planning when deploying automation in production. High attention to detail when making automated changes to production infrastructure. Strong documentation and communication skills. Ability to work as a technical SME and collaborate with network, infrastructure, and application teams. Strong ownership and accountability for production automation. Job Summary As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. OR Master''s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. OR PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field. 12+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 3+ years of experience with circuit/logic design/validation (e.g., digital, analog, RF). 3+ years of experience utilizing schematic capture and circuit stimulation software. 3+ years of experience with hardware design and measurement instruments such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, RF tools, etc. 1+ year in a technical leadership role with or without direct reports. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Leverages advanced Hardware knowledge and experience to plan, optimize, verify, and test highly critical electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems. Participates in or leads the implementation of advanced design rules and processes for electronic hardware, equipment, and/or integrated circuitry. Conducts highly complex simulations and analyses of designs as well as implements designs with the best power, performance, and area. Collaborates with cross-functional teams (e.g., design, verification, validation, software and systems engineering, architecture development teams, etc.) to implement new requirements and incorporate the latest test solutions in the production program to improve the yield, test time, and quality. Evaluates, characterizes, and develops novel manufacturing solutions for leading edge products in the most advanced processes and bring-up product to meet customer expectations and schedules. Evaluates reliability of highly critical materials, properties, and techniques and brings innovation, automation, and optimization to maximize productivity. Advises and leads engineers in the development of complex hardware designs, evaluating various design features to identify potential flaws or issues. Writes detailed technical documentation for highly complex Hardware projects; reviews technical documentation for junior engineers. Level of Responsibility Works independently with minimal supervision. Provides supervision/guidance to other team members. Decision-making is significant in nature and affects work beyond immediate work group. Requires verbal and written communication skills to convey complex information. May require negotiation, influence, tact, etc. Has a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions.

title: Modem design/RTL (Sr Staff)
description:
General Summary: Roles and Responsibilities Qualcomm modem team is looking for world-class RTL design engineers looking to work on cutting edge wireless technology, which will be deployed worldwide in our industry leading devices. You will be contributing to and leading a team for RTL design and integration of one or more flagship modem core IPs. Responsibilities include: Microarchitecture development and specification. From early high-level architectural exploration, through micro architectural research and arriving at a detailed specification. RTL ownership. Development, assessment and refinement of RTL design to target power, performance, area and timing goals Working collaboratively with block designers, verification, architecture, implementation, and post-silicon teams to resolve issues and ensure timely project execution. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, debugging and identifying issues, providing workarounds, and making recommendations on bug fixes. Leading and mentoring a team of engineers, providing technical guidance to the team Leading overall project planning efforts and execution. Skillset required The candidate must have at least 10 years of front-end ASIC RTL design experience. The candidate must be strong in design micro-architecture and RTL coding (SystemVerilog / Verilog / VHDL). Experience in Logic design /micro-architecture / RTL coding is a must . Must have hands on experience with SoC design and integration for SoCs. Experience in Verilog/System-Verilog is a must . Should have knowledge of AMBA protocols - AXI, AHB, APB, SoC clocking/reset/debug architecture and peripherals like USB, PCIE and SDCC. Other requirements include: Hands-on experience with multi-clock designs. Exposure to synthesis and STA. Awareness of low power and high-speed design. Knowledge of industry-standard front-end tool flows (lint, CDC, etc.). Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills. Flexible to work with multi-geo teams. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 
 OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 
 OR PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Sr. Manager Procurement | Solar Cells (RM Category A) Department 
 Procurement / Supply Chain Function 
 Raw Material Procurement – Solar Cells Position 
 Sr. Manager – Procurement Category 
 RM Category A – Solar Cells Location 
 As per business requirement Reporting To 
 Head / GM – Procurement & Supply Chain A. JOB OBJECTIVE To manage end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) activities for RM Category A – Solar Cells, ensuring uninterrupted material availability, competitive sourcing, timely procurement, effective supplier management, and delivery as per production and business requirements. The role will drive strategic vendor development, cost optimization, supplier performance, process improvements, and cross-functional coordination to strengthen supply reliability and overall procurement effectiveness. B. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own end-to-end P2P procurement for Solar Cells, covering supply planning, sourcing, purchase requisition, PO processing, approval coordination, logistics, delivery planning, and closure. Develop and execute procurement plans aligned with production schedules, sales commitments, inventory norms, and business demand. Manage strategic suppliers and ensure timely availability of Solar Cells as per quantity, quality, specification, price, and delivery requirements. Lead vendor onboarding, qualification, evaluation, development, and periodic performance reviews for strategic suppliers. Build and maintain long-term supplier partnerships to ensure continuity of supply, commercial competitiveness, and responsive support during demand fluctuations. Drive commercial negotiations covering price, payment terms, credit period, MOQ, lead time, freight, warranty/claims, and other contractual terms. Coordinate PO creation, amendments, approvals, order confirmation, and follow-up to ensure timely execution. Coordinate LC opening, approval, amendment, and closure with Finance/Treasury and relevant internal stakeholders, wherever applicable. Plan and coordinate inbound logistics, shipment schedules, documentation, customs/clearing coordination, and delivery to ensure material reaches the plant within required timelines. Monitor supplier order fulfilment, shipment status, inventory pipeline, and potential supply risks; initiate corrective actions and escalation where required. Track supplier OTIF performance, lead time, quality issues, shortages, claims, and commercial deviations through defined KPIs and dashboards. Identify alternate suppliers and develop contingency plans for critical materials to mitigate supply disruption and business continuity risks. Drive cost optimization through strategic sourcing, price benchmarking, volume consolidation, negotiation, alternate sourcing, and value-engineering opportunities. Collaborate with Production, Planning, Quality, Finance, Logistics, Stores, Engineering, and other stakeholders to resolve procurement and supply-related issues. Ensure procurement transactions and documentation comply with company policies, approval matrices, audit requirements, and applicable statutory/commercial guidelines. Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, standardization, and process improvement across the procurement cycle. Prepare and present procurement MIS, spend analysis, supplier performance, savings, open PO, delivery, inventory pipeline, and risk reports to management. Support annual budgeting, procurement strategy, supplier capacity planning, and long-term sourcing initiatives for Solar Cell requirements. C. STRATEGIC / VALUE-ADD RESPONSIBILITIES Develop category strategy for Solar Cells based on demand outlook, supplier landscape, capacity, pricing trends, technology changes, and supply risk. Build a robust supplier ecosystem with focus on reliability, scalability, quality, cost competitiveness, and business continuity. Lead supplier development initiatives to improve delivery adherence, responsiveness, quality, and overall supplier capability. Drive should-cost analysis, market intelligence, benchmark studies, and commercial analytics to support sourcing decisions. Identify and implement procurement savings and working-capital improvement initiatives without compromising supply continuity or quality. Establish risk-monitoring mechanisms for critical suppliers, including capacity, financial/commercial, logistics, geopolitical, and supply-chain risks. D. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Material availability / supply continuity Supplier OTIF and delivery adherence Procurement cost savings and cost avoidance Purchase price variance / price competitiveness Inventory and working-capital optimization Supplier quality and complaint closure PO and LC processing turnaround time Supplier onboarding and development effectiveness Critical supply risk mitigation Process compliance, audit readiness, and procurement cycle-time improvement E. EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commerce, or a related discipline; MBA / PG qualification in Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, or related field preferred. Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in Procurement / Strategic Sourcing / Supply Chain, preferably in Solar, Renewable Energy, Electronics, Electrical, Semiconductor, Manufacturing, or a related industry. Strong experience in strategic procurement and end-to-end P2P operations, preferably handling critical / high-value raw material categories. Experience in Solar Cell procurement, supplier ecosystem, international sourcing, LC-based transactions, and inbound logistics will be an advantage. F. CORE COMPETENCIES Strategic Sourcing & Category Management Supplier Relationship & Vendor Development Commercial Negotiation & Cost Optimization P2P / Procurement Process Management Supply Planning & Material Availability Logistics & Delivery Management LC / Trade Finance Coordination Supplier Risk & Performance Management Data Analysis, MIS & Procurement Dashboards Cross-functional Stakeholder Management Problem Solving, Decision Making & Process Improvement G. SYSTEMS / TOOLS Hands-on experience with ERP procurement modules such as Oracle / SAP or equivalent. Strong proficiency in MS Excel, data analysis, procurement dashboards, and reporting tools. Working knowledge of procurement analytics, supplier performance tracking, and digital sourcing tools. H. STAKEHOLDER INTERFACES Internal: Procurement, Supply Chain, Production, Planning, Quality, Finance, Treasury, Logistics, Stores, Engineering, Legal, and senior management. External: Strategic suppliers, manufacturers, logistics partners, freight forwarders, banks/trade-finance partners, and other supply-chain service providers. I. ROLE PROFILE The position requires strong ownership of critical raw material procurement, commercial acumen, supplier-management capability, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and time-sensitive supply requirements in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

description:
About Us 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you''ll have the opportunity to create impact at scale tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description 
 Visa''s Corporate IT (CIT) organization is on a transformational journey to redefine how enterprise technology enables global business scale, resilience, and employee productivity. We are moving beyond traditional infrastructure models toward software-defined, automated, cloud-integrated platforms that deliver security, reliability, and exceptional user experience at global scale. As part of this journey, the candidate will join a platform engineering team as a backend and systems-focused engineer, designing, developing, and implementing cross-platform client software and large-scale back-end microservices. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience building solutions for functionally complex, large-volume, high-throughput, data-centric distributed systems, with strong hands-on depth in Go and Java. The successful candidate is expected to be a design, coding, and configuration expert, and will help advance the engineering craft of the team related to architecture, distributed-systems design, code quality, scalability, resiliency, and CI/CD. The candidate should enjoy working on diverse technologies and functionally complex, data-centric distributed applications, should be excited to take initiatives to solve complex systems problems, and get the job done while taking on new challenges. You should thrive in team-oriented, fast-paced environments where each team member is vital to the overall success of the projects. Key responsibilities : Primary : Design, build, and maintain a cross-platform agent/plugin in Go (Golang). Design and build back-end microservices and APIs in Java / Spring Boot with a high level of scalability, resiliency, and monitoring. Build and operate an Apache Kafkabased streaming pipeline (producers/consumers), including partitioning, consumer groups, and delivery/lag management, across an Active/Active multidata-center topology. Containerize and deploy services using Docker and Kubernetes, and help define deployment, scaling, and operational patterns. Work with data stores ClickHouse (or an equivalent columnar/analytical store), PostgreSQL, and Redis including schema/data-model design and building efficient queries. Design and build GenAI-powered features and integrations e.g., natural-language interfaces, LLM-assisted workflows, and agentic automation integrating with LLM APIs and tooling. Contribute to the React front end as needed (secondary to back-end/agent work) and collaborate with UI-focused engineers on API contracts. Manage complex, multi-service dependencies across environments and data centers. Work with business partners, TPMs, and Product Managers to drive user-story grooming, functional/technical specifications, workflow designs, and use cases. Contribute to and help shape engineering best practices for the team. Stay abreast of emerging technologies, conduct POCs to prove concepts, and select the best solution approach. Work with limited direction within a complex distributed environment to drive delivery of solutions and meet service levels. Must be self-motivated with the ability to work in a fast-paced agile delivery model, collaborating with effective communication, quality, integrity, and reliable delivery. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications : 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor''s degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work Experience. Preferred Qualifications : 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor''s Degree, or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD) 5 or more years of relevant experience in application development (designing, coding, and testing), with strong hands-on depth in back-end and systems programming. Bachelors degree in computer science or another Engineering discipline. Strong hands-on experience with Go (Golang), building cross-platform plugins/agents. Solid experience in core Java and Spring Boot, building production back-end services; multithreaded/concurrent and high-throughput processing experience is important. Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (producers/consumers, partitioning, consumer groups, offsets/lag, delivery semantics). Experience with Docker and Kubernetes building, containerizing, deploying, and operating services. Solid experience with microservices architecture and distributed-systems design service decomposition, inter-service communication (REST/messaging), statelessness, fault tolerance, and designing for scalability, high availability, and multidata-center (Active/Active) operation. Demonstrated knowledge of RDBMS and SQL, with hands-on PostgreSQL experience; ability to build complex queries from a solid understanding of the data model. Experience with ClickHouse or an equivalent columnar / analytical database (or willingness to ramp quickly), and with Redis for caching. Experience building GenAI / LLM integrations working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and/or agent/tool (function-calling, MCP) integrations and applying them to real product features. Experience configuring CI/CD pipelines using industry-standard tools such as Git and Jenkins. Working knowledge of a modern JavaScript framework (React preferred). A fast learner and quick adapter able to ramp rapidly on new technologies, domains, and unfamiliar codebases, and to be productive with limited direction. Enjoy working fast and smart, and able to grasp complex concepts and build algorithms from scratch. Proficiency with Agile development techniques. Strong interpersonal, facilitation, and communication (written and verbal) skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly. Ability to work in a complex organization to determine business and customer needs and provide the best solution. Candidate must be able to proficiently multi-task, with a strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams. Passionate about learning and applying new technologies and takes pride in delivering working software. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Position Dossier Senior Product Manager CollectIQ Product Management Group • Hyderabad, India 
 About Us Omega Healthcare Management Services® is an AI-driven healthcare solutions company that partners across the healthcare ecosystem to deliver breakthrough results by reimagining and elevating revenue operations. With a global presence spanning four countries, our team of 30,000+ professionals collaborates with hospitals, physician groups and healthcare providers to streamline operations, improve financial performance and elevate patient care outcomes. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced technology and a customer-centric approach to deliver innovative, scalable healthcare support solutions. About the Omega Digital Platform® The Omega Digital Platform® is our agentic AI engine. It leverages adaptive intelligence to drive automation across the revenue cycle, complemented by deep human expertise, to optimise performance and deliver sustained financial and clinical outcomes. The platform spans the revenue cycle end to end — patient access and eligibility at the front, documentation and coding integrity through the middle, and revenue recovery at the back — with a shared intelligence layer running beneath all three. Capability built once on the platform is available everywhere on it. About CollectIQ CollectIQ is the revenue recovery product of the Omega Digital Platform. It works the accounts receivable a provider has already earned but has not yet collected — denied, underpaid, unanswered and written-off claims. Most denied revenue is recoverable, and most of it is never recovered. Not through poor execution, but because the cost of pursuing a claim frequently exceeds what it is expected to return. The binding constraint in back-end revenue cycle management is claim economics, not staff capacity. Adding people does not solve it; lowering the unit cost of a resolution does, because it makes previously unworkable inventory worth working. CollectIQ is built on that premise. It is an orchestration product, not a workflow tool — and the distinction defines the work. A workflow tool assumes the work is human, and exists to make a person faster at a task a person was always going to do. CollectIQ treats the human as one execution path among several — alongside autonomous agents, digital pathways, bots and voice — selected when the economics and the confidence support it. Every claim is assessed, valued, routed to the most efficient sufficient path, resolved, written back to the client system and reconciled, with outcomes feeding back to improve the next decision. The product is delivered as AI plus human workforce: technology does the work wherever it can, and people take only what genuinely needs judgement. Because Omega performs this work at scale across a large provider base, CollectIQ learns from real resolution outcomes — an advantage very few organisations in this market are positioned to build. Position Position Title: Senior Product Manager – CollectIQ Department: Product Management Group Location: Hyderabad, India Reports to: Associate Vice President – Product Management Role Type: Individual contributor You will own a product lane within CollectIQ — one or more categories of accounts receivable, taken from zero to one. You will define the problem, scope the solution, ship it with engineering, prove it at a client, and scale it. This is a builder's role, not a backlog-administration role. Responsibilities Own product strategy for your lane. Define the vision, roadmap and sequencing. Make build, buy and partner decisions and defend them with evidence. Lead discovery. Work directly with operations teams, clients and claims data to find where recovery economics break down. Translate ambiguous business problems into scoped, phased product bets. Define AI and automation capabilities end to end. Specify how work is detected, prioritised, routed, executed and closed — including where a human reviews, approves or overrides the system. Govern autonomy responsibly. Set confidence thresholds and escalation rules, design how overrides are captured, and expand automation on measured evidence rather than optimism. Write requirements engineering can build from. PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria grounded in real claim scenarios, with clear definitions of done. Define and instrument success metrics before the build. Own adoption, resolution quality, unit economics and business impact for your lane — and own building the measurement where it does not yet exist. Partner across functions. Work with engineering, data science, operations, implementation and client-facing teams from discovery through go-live and iteration. Run the agile cadence your team needs. Manage partner and vendor capabilities. Where we integrate rather than build, define the integration contract, the data terms and the performance bar. Communicate with clarity. Present direction, trade-offs, risks and results to senior leadership and clients — precise, concise and free of padding. Stay current. Track industry movement in revenue cycle automation, agentic AI and payer behaviour, and bring it back into the roadmap. Requirements 7+ years of overall experience, with substantial time as a Product Manager or Product Owner in a product-led organisation. We are not setting an upper limit. What we assess is what you have built, not how long you have been building. The differentiator is demonstrated 01 ownership — a capability you defined, shipped and grew from nothing into production use. Seniority beyond that is welcome and will be levelled accordingly. Essential Proven track record of defining, building, launching and scaling products as an individual contributor. Experience with AI-enabled or data-driven products: identifying and prioritising automation use cases, partnering with data science and ML teams, and defining success metrics for AI features such as accuracy, adoption and business impact. You interrogate data yourself rather than waiting for a report. SQL or equivalent is a significant plus. Technical literacy sufficient to hold your own on APIs, data flows, integration patterns and system design. You need not be an engineer, but you must be credible with them. Fluency in agile product development — Scrum and Kanban — with sound judgement on scope and schedule trade-offs. Exceptional written communication. You will be assessed on a written product document, not a deck. Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, with high ownership and a bias for action. Preferred Product experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with exposure to accounts receivable, denials, appeals, underpayments or claim lifecycle workflows.
