At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the worlds leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By Connecting Convenience across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. Role Overview: PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against - keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment. This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort - the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market - with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve. As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high-quality, high-value features. Youll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired. This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done - accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality. Key Responsibilities: Stay aligned with and contribute to the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering-ready PRDs and user stories Help define and evolve requirements for MEMs publishing engine - how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app As needed, extend into Mobile Platform-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices Develop documentation for new mobile and MEM features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications Own release planning for Mobile Platform and MEM initiatives Qualifications: Prior experience with consumer-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) - writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred Experience with platform, framework, or configurable/multi-tenant products is a strong plus, given the customizable nature of the Mobile Platform Comfort defining requirements for a 0-to-1 product (like MEM) with evolving scope, including working with design on portal/UI workflows Ability to break down ambiguous roadmap items and solution briefs into scoped, sequenced, engineering-ready PRDs Familiarity with mobile-specific considerations (app store release processes, platform guidelines, mobile UX patterns) is a plus Fluent with - or genuinely eager to learn - AI-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast-paced environment 2-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms and vice versa Ability to work independently as a contributing member of a high-paced, focused team, managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work under pressure Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority Collaborative by nature, with a strong desire to dig in and learn independently and through asking questions Comfortable partnering with and reporting to leadership based in the U.S., with strong cross-time-zone communication habits Working knowledge of product and sprint backlog tracking, burn-down metrics, velocity, and work breakdown techniques Solid understanding of Agile software development processes and principles Bachelor s degree in business, computer science, or equivalent work experience Preferred Skills: Domain experience in Convenience Retail, ERP, Logistics, or Financial transaction processing solutions Behavioral Competencies: Ensures Accountability Manages Complexity Communicates Effectively Balances Stakeholders Collaborates Effectively PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Sr Research Analyst - Pricing
description:
Senior Research Analyst Location - Vellore 
 Job Overview FactEntry is looking for a detail-oriented Senior Research Analyst to join the Bond Valuation Team . The role is primarily responsible for calculating, validating, and maintaining accurate daily prices and valuations across a broad range of fixed-income securities, including government bonds, corporate bonds, inflation-linked bonds, floating-rate notes, and other fixed-income instruments. The position involves validating prices and yields against external market sources, investigating pricing exceptions and significant market movements, and ensuring the accuracy and consistency of pricing across systems. The role also requires hands-on involvement in accrued interest, cash-flow calculations, inflation indexation, floating-rate calculations, and related pricing methodologies. The analyst will collaborate closely with Market Data, Reference Data, Operations, Technology, Product, and Client-facing teams to resolve pricing discrepancies, strengthen pricing controls, and improve existing processes. Key Responsibilities Calculate and validate daily prices for government, corporate, inflation-linked, floating-rate, and other fixed-income securities. Apply appropriate pricing methodologies, including YTM, spread, discount margin, clean/dirty price, and present value . Calculate accrued interest and settlement values. Perform cross-source validation to ensure pricing and market data accuracy. Maintain and validate government and benchmark yield curves. Investigate significant day-over-day price movements and pricing exceptions. Compare calculated prices and yields against external market sources. Maintain tolerance checks and exception reports. Set up and validate newly issued securities in the pricing system. Handle securities linked to CPI, RPI, and other inflation indices , including inflation index calculations and indexation factors. Perform floating-rate reset calculations and apply relevant reference-rate conventions. Validate coupon schedules, payment dates, maturity dates, and day-count conventions. Apply business-day calendars and appropriate holiday adjustments. Investigate and resolve pricing discrepancies reported by clients, Operations, or downstream systems. Respond to client queries relating to bond prices, yields, and valuation methodologies. Prepare and perform Client Coverage Reports . Maintain documentation relating to FRNs, Government Benchmark Yield Curves, and Inflation . Identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline pricing and validation processes. Qualifications Experience in Fixed Income Reference Data Operations and Corporate Actions . Minimum 1 + years of relevant experience as a Research Analyst. Working knowledge of SQL . Strong understanding of fixed-income instruments, bond attributes, terms and conditions, and lifecycle events. Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills. High attention to detail and a strong focus on data quality. Good communication and documentation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office . Preferred Experience Experience in new-issuance bond processing. Experience handling fixed-income corporate action changes. Experience reviewing bond prospectuses and issuer documentation. Exposure to data quality validation and/or reference data teams. Knowledge of bond pricing, valuation methodologies, yield calculations, and market conventions. Key Skills Strong knowledge of Fixed Income instruments and bond markets . Good understanding of bond attributes, terms conditions, and lifecycle events. Strong analytical and research capabilities. High attention to detail. Strong problem-solving and data-quality orientation. Process-oriented approach with a focus on continuous improvement. Effective communication and documentation skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong time-management skills. Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to evolving market and technology requirements. Core Competencies Attention to Detail Analytical Thinking Problem Solving Data Quality Orientation Process Orientation Collaboration Teamwork Communication Skills Time Management Continuous Learning

Asset Liability Committee, Risk committee) highlighting key capital and liquidity metrics, risks, gaps remediation plans Contribute to the India regulatory returns automation project

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager Location: Gurugram
 Department: Accounts & Finance
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Experience: 5+ Years
 Qualification: CA / CPA preferred
 Industry: International Education / Higher Education About the Role We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to manage accounting and financial operations for our Canadian higher-education and associated business entities. The role will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, statutory compliance, audit coordination, revenue and receivables management, and team leadership. The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to international accounting, Canadian accounting practices, IFRS/Canada GAAP, QuickBooks, MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis . The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Operations, Marketing, IT, institutional stakeholders, vendors, students, and senior Finance leadership. Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Financial Operations Oversee day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate and timely maintenance of books of accounts. Manage accounting activities across Canadian higher-education entities and associated group companies. Review appropriate booking and classification of income and expenses in QuickBooks . Ensure accurate revenue recognition and classification of deferred revenue. Monitor timely invoicing and accounting of revenues. Review Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable transactions. Ensure refunds, commissions, incentives, petty cash and other financial trackers are updated accurately and on time. Review credit card statements and ensure expenses are appropriately approved and within budget. Review and finalize monthly books of accounts before submission to the Controller and CFO. 2. MIS & Financial Reporting Prepare and present accurate weekly and monthly MIS reports. Prepare Actual vs. Budget analysis for revenue, enrollment, expenses and profitability. Prepare entity-wise financial analysis and management reports. Monitor enrollment/deposit status and financial performance across entities. Track lead-generation costs, conversion costs and associated financial metrics. Prepare month-end review reports and highlight key variances and financial insights to management. 3. Budgeting & Forecasting Lead annual budgeting exercises in collaboration with Sales and other business teams. Translate annual budgets into monthly and periodic targets. Monitor actual performance against budgets and identify significant variances. Prepare rolling forecasts based on actual business performance. Work closely with Sales and Marketing to align revenue targets, lead-generation budgets and business expenditure. Ensure expenses remain within approved budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization. 4. Revenue & Receivables Management Ensure correct classification of revenue and deferred revenue. Monitor Accounts Receivable and follow up on outstanding receivables. Ensure bad debts are appropriately identified and recorded. Review student-related receivables and support timely collections. Monitor revenue realization against business targets. Work with Sales and Operations teams to improve revenue visibility and collection efficiency. 5. Audit & Statutory Compliance Coordinate internal and external audit requirements. Ensure timely preparation and submission of financial information required for audits and regulatory reviews. Ensure compliance with applicable IFRS / Canadian accounting standards and statutory requirements . Support financial submissions required for institutional licensing, certification and regulatory renewals. Review audit observations and ensure corrective actions are implemented within agreed timelines. Ensure timely completion of recurring financial and statutory compliances while avoiding penalties and interest. 6. Process Improvement & Financial Controls Review existing Finance policies, processes and SOPs and recommend improvements. Drive standardization across accounting and reporting processes. Identify opportunities for process automation and operational efficiency. Strengthen financial controls and ensure adherence to approved processes. Ensure consistent and accurate accounting practices across entities. 7. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Sales, Operations, Brand & Marketing, IT and other functions on financial and business matters. Participate in regular cross-functional meetings to review business performance, budgets, revenue and operational requirements. Collaborate with Canadian teams, institutions, vendors, third parties and other stakeholders. Provide financial insights to support business decisions. 8. Team Management & Development Lead and manage the accounting team responsible for respective entities. Set clear goals, KPIs and performance expectations for team members. Delegate responsibilities with defined timelines and ensure timely completion. Monitor team performance and resolve operational issues. Provide coaching, training and guidance to team members. Identify training and development requirements within the Finance team. Foster a collaborative, accountable and performance-oriented work environment. Key Performance Areas (KRA) Financial Reporting: Accurate and timely weekly/monthly/quarterly reporting. Book Closure: Timely and accurate month-end closure and maintenance of books. Budgeting & Forecasting: Effective budget preparation, monitoring and variance analysis. Revenue Management: Accurate revenue recognition, deferred revenue management and receivables monitoring. Audit & Compliance: Timely completion of audits and statutory/regulatory requirements. Cost Management: Effective monitoring and control of business expenses against approved budgets. Process Improvement: Standardization, control strengthening and process automation. Team Leadership: Effective management, coaching and development of the accounting team. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong coordination with Sales, Operations, Marketing, IT and other stakeholders. Required Skills & Experience 5+ years of experience in accounting and finance, preferably with significant exposure to international accounting . CA / CPA qualification preferred. Strong understanding of Canadian accounting practices and IFRS / Canada GAAP . Experience managing accounting operations for multiple entities. Strong knowledge of QuickBooks and financial reporting. Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, MIS and variance analysis. Strong understanding of revenue recognition, deferred revenue, AP, AR and month-end closing. Experience handling statutory audits and regulatory compliance. Strong financial analysis and management reporting skills. Experience managing and developing accounting teams. Strong Excel and data-analysis skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder-management and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work effectively with international teams and cross-functional stakeholders. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a CA/CPA or equivalent finance professional with strong international accounting exposure, preferably in a Canadian or North American business environment. The candidate should be comfortable managing multiple entities, leading a finance team, reviewing financial statements, driving budgets and forecasts, and working directly with senior Finance and business stakeholders.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Job Description: Principal / Lead Data Engineer (PySpark, SQL) Role & Requirements Overview Exp: 10+ Years 

 Role Overview We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated Principal / Lead Data Engineer to join our dynamic data platform team in either our Gurgaon or Chennai office. The successful candidate will be a critical player in designing, building, and optimizing our next-generation data architecture and pipelines. This role requires expert-level proficiency in PySpark and SQL, alongside a proven track record of architecting scalable, high-performance ETL/ELT processes. You will transform vast amounts of raw data into high-quality, actionable insights for analytics, reporting, and Machine Learning. Given the seniority of this role, we are looking for a seasoned leader and immediate joiner who can hit the ground running and contribute significantly from day one. 
 Key Responsibilities Data Pipeline Development & Optimization Design and Build: Architect, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant ETL/ELT pipelines for ingesting data from diverse sources (e.g., databases, APIs, streaming sources) into our data lake and data warehouse. PySpark Expertise: Write and optimize complex data transformation jobs using PySpark and the Spark DataFrame API to process petabytes of structured and unstructured data efficiently. SQL Mastery: Utilize Advanced SQL for complex querying, data manipulation, stored procedures, performance tuning, and optimizing database schema design in relational and analytical databases. Data Quality & Governance: Implement data validation, cleansing, and monitoring routines to ensure high data quality, integrity, and adherence to security and governance standards. Architecture and Infrastructure Data Modeling: Design and implement optimal data models (e.g., Dimensional Modeling, Data Vault, Snowflake Schema) for our data warehouse to support business intelligence and analytical needs. Cloud Integration: Drive cloud-native data solutions primarily leveraging Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and Synapse (or comparable frameworks like AWS S3/Redshift and Google BigQuery) to build and deploy data solutions. Automation: Implement orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or AWS Step Functions to automate data workflows and manage pipeline dependencies. Collaboration and Operational Excellence Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Product Managers, and Business Stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into high-level technical specifications. Monitoring & Support: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve critical issues in production data pipelines, ensuring maximum uptime and timely data delivery. Best Practices & Mentorship: Lead code reviews, enforce strict coding standards, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to the continuous improvement of development and deployment practices (CI/CD, Git). 
 Required Technical Skills (Mandatory) Certification: Active Azure Databricks Certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional). PySpark: Expert-level, hands-on experience in developing, tuning, and optimizing large-scale data processing applications using PySpark (Python for Apache Spark). SQL: Mastery of Advanced SQL (including window functions, complex joins, stored procedures, and query performance tuning) across various database systems (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL). Programming: Strong proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and general data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas). Big Data Architecture: Deep understanding of Big Data concepts, distributed systems architecture, data lakes, and modern data warehousing principles. ETL/ELT: Proven experience in designing and implementing enterprise-grade ETL/ELT pipelines. 
 Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have) Hands-on experience with wider Azure ecosystem components (Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Key Vault). Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools like Apache Airflow. Experience with real-time/streaming data processing (e.g., Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka, or Event Hubs). Advanced knowledge of Data Governance, Data Cataloging, and Data Security best practices. Candidate Profile Educational Background: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Mindset: Proactive, self-motivated, strategic thinker with a strong sense of ownership and urgency. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. 
 Availability: Must be an Immediate Joiner or have a short notice period (7 days maximum).

Key Skills: PySpark,Azure Databricks,SQL,Data Modeling,Data,Modeling,Microsoft Azure,Data Engineering

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Kubernetes Platform & Networking
description:
Who are we Equinix is the worlds digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriersbecause progress starts with fresh ideas. Youll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes youbecause when you feel valued, youre empowered to do your best work. Job Summary We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform''s architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps. This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves. You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems. Responsibilities OS Provisioning Bare-Metal Infrastructure Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them Kubernetes Control Plane Worker Nodes Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded CI/CD Data Plane Deployment Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks Network Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over OS Kubernetes Upgrades Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live Apply the platform''s patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components Management Plane Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free On-Call Incident Management Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements Qualifications Required OS bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; description:
About StarRez 
StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. About The Role As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of product workstreams, acting as the bridge between Product Managers and the development teams. While the Product Manager focuses more on leading the relevant product vision and strategy and generating impactful roadmaps, your role will be to ensure flawless execution of that body of work in conjunction with your Product Engineering team. That includes owning requirements and Acceptance Criteria, grooming the backlog and helping deliver quality software to market. Additionally, you will own and lead well defined projects, as agreed with the Product Manager, to deliver incremental value toward the Product and Technology department s goals. Ultimately, the Product Manager and the Product Owner collaborate to deliver world class outcomes for our business. What You Will Own Backlog Management Prioritization Own and manage the product backlog for your assigned product or workstream. Collaborate with the Product Manager to understand product goals and ensure backlog prioritization aligns with strategic objectives. Clearly define user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements in collaboration with the engineering and design teams. Delivery Execution Maintain alignment with the product roadmap, ensuring backlog items are prioritized and executed in line with roadmap goals. Identify and independently own well defined initiatives, as agreed with the Product Manager, ensuring successful delivery of these workstreams. Stakeholder Collaboration Coordinate with Product Managers to gather business requirements and translate them into actionable tasks. Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to ensure all executed work aligns with the product vision and strategic outcomes for the area. Actively engage with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Design, Quality, and Customer Success. Refinement Continuous Improvement Assist backlog refinement sessions, sprint planning, and retrospectives, continuously improving processes and team effectiveness. Support all relevant agile processes that the team follows, ensuring high levels of collaboration and accountability. Analyze and incorporate feedback from users, Quality, and internal stakeholders to refine features and improve outcomes. Product Quality Value Delivery Collaborate to ensure the delivered product increments meet quality standards and deliver value to users. Track and report on key delivery metrics, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring alignment with product goals. Ensure proper documentation of delivered features and support the go-to market process in collaboration with Product Managers. Work with the Product Manager to determine optimizations to live features and incremental work that may further enhance the delivery of outcomes. Required Qualification 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, or similar role in a SaaS environment. Strong understanding of agile product development frameworks, including Scrum or Kanban. Proven track record of managing complex product backlogs and delivering high impact features on time. Excellent collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and QA. Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey requirements and priorities to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Analytical mindset, with the ability to break down complex problems into actionable solutions. Experience working closely with Product Managers to translate strategic goals into deliverable tasks. Familiarity with product management and development tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Miro etc) Preferred Qualification Experience working in B2B SaaS, particularly in Property Tech or Housing. Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar agile certification. Understanding of user-centered design principles and product discovery techniques. title: Technical Support Group leader
description:
Why This Role Exists The MR business is carrying a recurring, escalating problem: field issues at customer sites are consuming the time of Physical-AI NPD engineers, who are the people responsible for building the long-term platform franchise. The reason this happens is structural the Technical Support Group (TSG), the function that should sit between the field (I&C L1) and engineering (NPD), is leaderless, understaffed, and underskilled. A leaderless group cannot self-improve, cannot triage incoming work, and cannot say no to overflow. The consequence is not just a delivery gap it is a strategic drain that mortgages the future to pay for the present. The TSG Team Lead is the single most important appointment in the MR value stream right now. Without this person in place, no other TSG action staffing, skilling, certification will hold. With this person in place, the reinforcing loop (ship incomplete site firefight NPD pulled platform delayed more bespoke pressure) can be broken. Role Mission Financial impact: Contribute partl to the 912 Cr savings target through I&C savings reduce rework man-days, accelerate ramp-up, and eliminate site escalations that consume engineering cost. Protect the Physical-AI NPD franchise from being consumed by short-term site firefighting. Functional impact: Build, lead, and continuously improve the TSG (L2) as the definitive buffer between field execution (I&C L1) and engineering (NPD Design). Own the technical resolution of all L2 field issues, the NPD Firewall, and the standard-track validation capability for the two-tier pre-ship gate. Emotional impact: Create a TSG that the I&C team trusts to escalate to without hesitation, that customers feel safe in the hands of, and that NPD engineers are confidently protected by so the team that builds the future can stay focused on the future. Key Outcomes (WHO Scorecard what winning looks like) These are the 5 results the TSG Team Lead is hired to deliver. Each has a measurable indicator. Performance in year 1 will be assessed against these outcomes. Live accounts stabilised TEPL, Visteon, DICV, CATEvery open issue triaged and routed within 30 days of joining: product-defect ( back-office SWAT/Design) vs site-execution ( TSG owns). No issue sits unclassified. Open issue register: 100% triaged by day 30 NPD Firewall operationalZero unlogged NPD-to-site pulls within 30 days. Every exception: senior-approved, time-capped, and documented. NPD teams report freedom to work on platform. 0 unlogged NPD pulls; exception log visible monthly TSG team staffed and L2-capableHeadcount plan agreed, hiring initiated, and skilling/certification path defined and running within 90 days. Team resolves running-site issues independently (without NPD) within 180 days. TSG team certified per plan by day 180 Two-tier validation gate: TSG contribution operationalTSG provides the standard-track validation resource for all new projects from Q1 FY27. First-unit validation is never deferred to site. 0 projects reaching site with deferred standard-track validation from Q1 FY27 I&C savings: reduction in site firefighting costMeasured as: site man-days lost to unresolved L2 issues, number of NPD-to-site pulls, escalation frequency. All declining quarter on quarter. Month-on-month reduction in site firefighting man-days; tracked as I&C savings contribution Scope and Key Responsibilities The role has five distinct responsibility areas, listed in order of priority for the first 180 days. TSG L2 Leadership Building the function Define the TSG what it is, what it is not, what L2 means in the MR context. Communicate clearly internally. Design and agree the TSG headcount plan with Manish and Biren initial team size, skill profiles, hiring timeline. Own the work prioritisation for TSG. Define and enforce the triage decision tree: what TSG resolves, what goes to back-office SWAT (Ashfaq's team), what goes to NPD only under exception. Build a skilling and certification path for the team what does an L2-certified TSG engineer look like? Define, publish, and track. Set performance standards and review cadence for the TSG team. The leader is accountable for the group's output, not just their own technical contribution. Eventually transition the TSG under Shailesh Sule (Customer Success Ops Head) as the function matures. Running Lane Immediate recovery (first 3090 days) Take immediate ownership of L2 technical support for live accounts: TEPL, Visteon, DICV, CAT. Conduct issue classification: product-defect vs site-execution. Route each correctly and confirm routing with PMO (Sameer) within 30 days. Provide direct L2 field support for I&C escalations be present at site when required. Build and deploy the dispatch software support capability within TSG this is a specific gap identified in the value stream. Complete deferred validation at live accounts under controlled conditions document what was skipped and run the protocols. Deploy customer-confidence communication protocol with Site Incharges time-bound recovery plans that rebuild trust. NPD Firewall Guardian of the platform franchise Own and enforce the NPD Firewall from day 1. The rule: Physical-AI NPD engineers are not available for site firefighting except under a controlled, senior-approved, time-capped, and logged exception. Negotiate the firewall boundary with NPD leadership and engineering get explicit agreement on what constitutes an 'exception' and what the approval chain is. Log every NPD-to-site pull, every exception, every time the firewall holds. Report drain visibility to Manish and Shailesh monthly. Be the person who says 'no' on behalf of NPD absorb the escalation pressure so NPD does not have to. Over time, build TSG capability so the number of legitimate exceptions declines to near-zero. Validation Capability Two-tier gate contribution Partner with Anand (V&V Quality gate owner) to understand the standard-track validation requirements for the two-tier pre-ship gate. Build TSG as the execution arm of standard-track validation the team that conducts fast incoming checks vs known-good baseline for all standard products. Ensure TSG engineers are certified to run standard-track validation for each robot family they support. Feed custom-track validation gaps (where product fell outside standard paths) back to Design (Adrian) and Controls (Sourabh) for root-cause correction. New Lane Process and lifecycle support Represent TSG in the I-C-R-H lifecycle RACI define clearly where L2/TSG sits in the Install, Commission, Ramp-up, and HyperCare phases. Partner with Chetan Sharma (I&C) to define the L1 L2 escalation protocol: what triggers escalation, expected response time, and resolution ownership. Build knowledge management within TSG structured capture of field issues, resolutions, and root causes. Feed recurring patterns to Design, Controls, and Quality for prevention. Develop TSG SOPs and resolution playbooks for the most common field scenarios. Reduce dependency on individual knowledge. KPIs How Performance Will Be Measured Time to triage all open issues at live accounts (TEPL, Visteon, DICV, CAT) Day 30 from start NPD Firewall: unlogged NPD-to-site pulls Zero TSG team headcount plan agreed and hiring initiated Day 45 from start TSG team L2-certified (per robot family) Day 180 from start Site man-days lost to L2-unresolved escalations (monthly) Reducing MoM baseline set at start Standard-track validation: % projects with TSG sign-off before site dispatch 100% from Q1 FY27 NPD-to-site pulls per quarter (logged exceptions) Declining QoQ Customer NPS for accounts with TSG coverage NPS +50 aligned I&C savings contribution (rework reduction + faster ramp) Reported monthly as part of 912 Cr program Competencies (Role-specific + Behavioural) Competencies are assessed through structured interviews and reference checks. Each competency below has both a technical and a behavioural dimension. Role-Specific Competencies Technical depth in robotics complex systems: Able to own and resolve multi-domain field issues (mechanical, electrical, controls, software) at L2 without escalating to NPD. Understands how AMR/AGV systems fail and how to diagnose systematically. Field operations expertise: Deep understanding of I&C execution, commissioning phases, site-customer dynamics, and what it takes to bring a complex system to stable production. Has spent time on-site, not just in the office. Team building and L2 function design: Proven ability to hire, skill, and develop an L2 engineering team. Knows what 'good' looks like for a technical support group and can build toward it. Structured problem-solving and RCA: Uses defined methods (5-Why, fault-tree, FMEA) to separate symptoms from root causes. Can classify issues rapidly and correctly without sending everything upstream. NPD interface management: Comfortable creating and enforcing organisational boundaries. Can negotiate the firewall with senior engineering leadership without losing the relationship or capitulating under pressure. Customer-facing technical communication: Can translate complex technical status into a credible, time-bound recovery plan that a non-technical customer can trust. De-escalates; does not hide. Candidate Profile The following is the target profile for the TSG Team Lead. These are the characteristics of an A-player in this role. Education B.E. B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline. Post-graduate qualification in engineering or management is a plus but not required. Experience Total experience: 10-14 years in industrial automation, robotics, or complex electromechanical systems integration. Field engineering technical support: minimum 4-5 years in an L2 or L3 escalation management, field applications engineering, or complex system commissioning role. Team leadership: minimum 3 years leading an engineering team hired people, set standards, managed performance. Product knowledge: deep familiarity with AMR or AGV systems, or equivalent complex automation (PLC/SCADA/motion control). Robotics-specific knowledge strongly preferred. Customer-facing experience: managed technical relationships with industrial customers under delivery pressure. Has delivered a credible recovery plan to a dissatisfied customer. NPD engineering interface: has experience working at the boundary between field support and product development knows how to escalate correctly without pulling the whole team. Ticketing: has experience working with tickets management systems knows how to manage a team under kanban process. What this person is NOT Not a pure field service engineer who has never built a team or managed a function. Not a pure project manager with shallow technical depth must be able to roll up their sleeves and diagnose a fault. Not someone who says yes to everything the firewall role requires comfortable, principled refusal. Not someone who needs a fully-defined function to operate in this role starts with ambiguity and creates structure.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Construction Manager Location: Project Site (Mumbai / Bengaluru / PAN India as required)
 Department: Projects & Construction
 Reporting To: Project Director / Head Projects / Managing Director Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and result-oriented Construction Manager to lead and manage end-to-end construction activities at project sites. The ideal candidate should have extensive hands-on experience working with reputed contractors, EPC organizations, industrial projects, or international construction environments and possess a strong understanding of construction methodologies, productivity management, labour efficiency, equipment utilization, quality systems, cost control, and project execution. The Construction Manager shall be responsible for delivering projects safely, within budget, on schedule, and to the highest quality standards while maximizing labour and equipment productivity. Key Responsibilities A. Construction Execution & Site Management Lead day-to-day construction activities and ensure smooth site execution. Develop and implement construction methodologies, work sequences, and execution strategies. Ensure execution is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, standards, and project requirements. Drive timely completion of project milestones and overall project delivery. Coordinate multiple agencies, subcontractors, consultants, vendors, and internal stakeholders. Resolve construction bottlenecks and site challenges proactively. B. Labour Productivity & Resource Management Plan and optimize labour deployment across various work fronts. Establish productivity benchmarks for all construction activities. Monitor labour efficiency and productivity on a daily basis. Identify productivity losses and implement corrective measures. Prepare and monitor labour deployment plans and manpower histograms. Ensure effective utilization of skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled workforce. Manage subcontractors and labour contractors to achieve planned outputs. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance site productivity. C. Equipment Planning & Utilization Plan equipment requirements based on project schedules and work fronts. Monitor equipment productivity, utilization, and downtime. Optimize deployment of cranes, excavators, batching plants, pumps, compressors, lifting equipment, and construction machinery. Analyze equipment efficiency and recommend improvements. Ensure preventive maintenance and operational readiness of equipment. D. Material Planning & Consumption Control Prepare material requirement plans based on construction schedules. Coordinate with procurement and stores teams for timely availability of materials. Monitor material consumption against budgeted quantities. Analyze wastage and implement measures to reduce material losses. Ensure proper storage, handling, and inventory management of construction materials. Review reconciliation reports for steel, concrete, blockwork, finishing materials, and other major resources. E. Cost Management & Budget Control Monitor construction costs against approved budgets. Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality and safety. Track productivity-related costs and resource utilization. Review subcontractor performance and commercial implications. Participate in forecasting, budgeting, and cost-control exercises. Support preparation of management reports highlighting project financial performance. F. Drawing Management & Technical Coordination Review IFC drawings, shop drawings, and construction details. Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, and project management teams. Identify design conflicts and ensure timely resolution. Ensure construction teams are working with the latest approved drawings. Participate in design coordination and technical review meetings. G. Quality Management Implement project quality assurance and quality control systems. Ensure compliance with approved specifications, codes, standards, and client requirements. Monitor inspection and testing activities. Drive first-time-right execution practices. Minimize rework through effective planning and supervision. Ensure proper documentation of inspections, approvals, and quality records. Lead quality improvement initiatives and root-cause analysis of defects. H. Planning & Progress Monitoring Coordinate with planning teams to develop detailed execution plans. Monitor project progress against baseline schedules. Identify delays and implement recovery plans. Participate in look-ahead planning and resource planning meetings. Ensure alignment between construction activities and project milestones. I. Safety Leadership Promote a strong safety culture across the project. Ensure compliance with company HSE requirements and statutory regulations. Conduct site inspections and safety reviews. Support implementation of safe work practices and permit systems. Participate in incident investigations and corrective action implementation. J. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead multidisciplinary construction teams. Mentor site engineers, supervisors, and construction staff. Conduct regular progress review meetings with contractors and consultants. Build collaborative relationships with clients, consultants, and project stakeholders. Drive accountability and performance across all site teams. Desired Skills & Competencies Technical Competencies Strong understanding of RCC, structural steel, finishing, infrastructure, and MEP coordination. Expertise in construction methodologies and sequencing. Strong knowledge of productivity measurement and benchmarking. Material management and reconciliation expertise. Cost control and resource optimization capabilities. Construction equipment planning and utilization management. Strong understanding of QA/QC systems. Ability to interpret construction drawings and technical specifications. Contract administration and subcontractor management skills. Managerial Competencies Leadership and team management. Decision-making and problem-solving. Planning and organizational skills. Stakeholder management. Negotiation and conflict resolution. Analytical and commercial acumen. Software Skills Microsoft Project Primavera P6 (Preferred) AutoCAD MS Excel (Advanced) ERP Systems Power BI (Preferred) Educational Qualification B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering M.Tech / PMP Certification (Preferred) Experience Minimum 1220 Years of Construction Experience. Experience with reputed contractors, EPC companies, industrial projects, data centers, manufacturing facilities, commercial developments, institutional projects, or international projects preferred. Proven experience managing large-scale projects independently. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Project milestone achievement. Labour productivity and efficiency. Equipment utilization efficiency. Material consumption versus budget. Cost variance against approved budget. Quality compliance and defect reduction. Safety performance indicators. Subcontractor performance management. Resource utilization efficiency. Client and stakeholder satisfaction. Preferred Candidate Profile Strong site execution background with hands-on construction management experience. Experience in managing large labour forces and multiple subcontractors. Demonstrated capability in improving productivity and controlling project costs. Ability to deliver fast-track projects under challenging timelines. Exposure to international construction practices or leading Indian contracting organizations will be an added advantage. Strong leadership presence with a proactive and ownership-driven approach.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.
 Responsibilities 
 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Track, analyze, and report on key engineering performance metrics (e.g., velocity, quality, cycle time), using insights to drive continuous improvement in team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications 
 What You Bring to the Team BS in Computer Science or a related field, or demonstrable equivalent experience. 8+ years of professional software development experience using technologies such as C#, WPF, Java, Python, and/or JavaScript. 4+ years of leadership experience with a focus on mentorship, career growth, and delivery. Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, from architecture to implementation. Strong grasp of software engineering best practices: Agile workflows, CI/CD, TDD, code reviews, and build/release automation. Experience working with Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with short release cycles and products in active production use. Deep knowledge of OOP principles, data structures, and algorithms. Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating AI tools into development workflows, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Committed to sound business ethics and handling of confidential information. Experience working in Product Operating Model is a plus.

Good To Have Skills

Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.Designation: Cyber Risk Engineer Job Location : Pune/Thiruvananthapuram Job PurposeThe cyber risk engineer will be responsible for providing cyber related exposure analysis and risk improvement consultancy services to Allianz Commercial large corporate cyber clients across several international locations. Identify potential cyber threats, attack vectors and vulnerabilities. Adopting with changing digitisation environment in cyber risk consulting and claims support. Key Requirements / Skills / Experience / Expertise  Bachelors/Masters' degree or higher in Cyber Security would be preferred or masters degree in computer science/Engineering, Information Technology and Information Systems, Distributed Computing, Network Structure, Software Developing, and AI. Information Security experience in Security Architecture, Governance, Network Engineering, Cloud Security, security tools/services, penetration testing, programming languages, malware assessment and risk management.  Experience in presenting complicate technical matters, clear communicate messages to different level of technical understanding stakeholders, able to articulate propositions to leaders in all levels of management.  Cybersecurity certification (e.g., CISSP, CISA, CRISC, CISM etc.)  Being responsible for system and/or network security of an organization/unit/company.  Expertise in Industrial Network Security of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) - Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Distributed Control Systems (DCS), and Information / IT Security  Knowledge of ICT Management Systems, Business Continuity Management, e2e digital value chain, and risk assessment methods and tools, is a plus.  Understanding complex IT infrastructures (hardware components; software  UNIX, Linux, Windows; network communication protocols  TCP/IP, Modbus, OPC, Database structures), various digital platforms, cloud computing, IoT, blockchain based solutions, AI business application.  Consulting experience in advising international companies about IT security project phases in the operational environment.Key Responsibilities  Perform cyber risk assessment desktop analysis of existing and/or potential Allianz Commercial Cyber clients, evaluating and summarising exposures, risk mitigation controls, and deliver cyber desktop assessment (DTA) reports for clients.  Carry out cyber risk dialogues or site surveys when required with large accounts, which involve complex cyber risks. Provide technical consultation to Allianz Commercial clients in relation to cyber exposures.  Understand, analyse, and provide insights on the Cyber global portfolio and its changing trends by compiling reports when required or by participating in relative ARC projects. Maintain and enhance technical skills and expertise in Cyber security to support global business development.  Improve and develop tools and methods to appropriately capture and quantity the diverse set of 1st and 3rd party cyber risks. Collaborate closely with the ARC Cyber Team and Underwriting in improving and promoting the Cyber product, using all the available digital tools.  Implement best practices for Cyber risk assessment in line with overall ARC processes and Functional Rules. Improve Cyber risk assessment processes by efficiency savings and reducing complexities. Perform quality control at work provided by 3rd parties.
